purpose: Review first-party Egyptian and Sharqia cadastral/map channels for anonymous parcel geometry with safe native identifiers.
assessment: Official national survey/map pages were reachable and documented general mapping and cadastral-related service responsibilities, but no anonymous parcel feature API was exposed. The Sharqia governorate spatial-variables portal returned an authentication page; its anonymous JavaScript exposed only a Leaflet basemap. No exact-point parcel request was made because no documented anonymous parcel endpoint existed. No geometry absence or citywide coverage conclusion is made.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custody is not sufficiently evidenced for this packet. National General Authority for Survey material is general agency evidence; the Sharqia local portal is operationally visible but login-gated and does not disclose a public parcel layer.
